chunks: Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:
"So avoid the filth of idols and avoid false speech."

He عليه السلام said: "The filth of idols is chess, and false speech is singing, and backgammon is more severe than chess. As for chess, adopting it is kufr, playing it is shirk, teaching it is a grave destructive sin, greeting one who is occupied with it is disobedience, and turning it over is like turning over the flesh of swine, and looking at it is like looking at the private part of one's mother. The one who plays backgammon as gambling is like one who eats the flesh of swine, and the example of the one who plays it without gambling is like one who puts his hand in the flesh of swine or in its blood. And it is not permissible to play with rings, the fourteen, and all that and their likes are gambling, even the play of children with walnuts is gambling. Beware of striking the small stones together, for indeed Shayṭān runs with you and the angels flee from you. And whoever has a ṭunbūr remaining in his house for forty mornings, then he has incurred wrath from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.الرِّجْسُ: ritual and moral filth or impurity mentioned in the verse
key_terms.الشِّطْرَنْجُ: chess, described here as a condemned game
key_terms.الصَّوَانِيجِ: small striking instruments or stones used in amusement
key_terms.النَّرْدُ: backgammon, described as more severe than chess
key_terms.الْأَوْثَانِ: idols, here linked in the report to condemned practices
key_terms.الْغِنَاءُ: singing, identified here as false speech
key_terms.قَوْلَ الزُّورِ: false speech, interpreted here as singing
key_terms.قِمَارٌ: gambling, the legal and moral category applied to these games

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام interpret the verse "avoid the filth of idols and avoid false speech" regarding chess, backgammon, and singing?
ai.summary: This report presents an interpretation of the Qur'anic command to avoid impurity and false speech by applying it to certain games and forms of entertainment. It emphasizes the severity of gambling-related amusements and censures musical diversion, framing them as spiritually corrupting and morally destructive.
